feeds.title: KFOR
feeds.description: Oklahoma's Own KFOR is Central Oklahoma's source for Oklahoma-area breaking news, streaming live video, traffic, and severe weather coverage. Read the Latest News and Updates in News brought to you by the team at KFOR. The station is owned by the Nexstar Media Group, as part of a duopoly with independent station KAUT-TV (channel 43).

feeds.title: Oklahoma Watch
feeds.description: Oklahoma Watch is a nonprofit news organization that produces in-depth and investigative journalism on important public-policy issues facing the state. Through investigative, fact-driven journalism, they dig deep and examine significant issues facing their state. Their work engages all Oklahomans, amplifies the discussion of important issues, and leads to change. They help develop the journalists and journalism of the future.

feeds.title: Oklahoma City Free Press
feeds.description: Oklahoma City Free Press is an independent reader-engaged community news from and for Oklahoma City. Oklahoma City Free Press is dedicated to providing high-quality journalism that positively impacts the community. They give a voice to those who aren't heard and expose that which is hidden from the public.

feeds.title: Osage News
feeds.description: As an independent news organization, Osage News strives to report news and information with fairness and balance. While being the official news organization of the Osage Nation, we base our news judgment on our loyalties to our readers and Osage citizens, and we are not directly beholden to the Executive, Legislative, or Judicial branches of the Osage Nation.

feeds.title: Shawnee News-Star
feeds.description: The Shawnee News-Star is an American daily newspaper. Our mission is to capitalize on our roots as a technology company to provide innovative media and technology services to our local communities while simultaneously improving the digital experience and engagement of our subscribers.

feeds.title: The Journal Record
feeds.description: Since 1903, The Journal Record Publishing Co. has been a multifaceted media company that specializes in business, a screenshot of news articles legislative, and legal-related information sources. Focus on local and statewide business trends and in-depth stories that convey the voice of the Oklahoma business community.

feeds.title: The Davis News
feeds.description: At DavisPaper.net, the online portal for The Davis News, you will find news and information pertaining to Davis, Murray County, and the surrounding region. We also feature coverage of National, Sports, Political, and Business areas outsourced from external newsrooms. Check out the latest posts to know the latest about Davis and rest of Okhlahoma.

feeds.title: Oklahoma Daily News
feeds.description: Informi9ng businesses, residents, and visitors, Oklahoma Daily News is a new resource for Oklahoma residents, businesses, and visitors. On Oklahoma Daily News we consistently add valuable resources and tools for our community, as well as informative articles related to business, lifestyle, and real estate in Oklahoma.

feeds.title: KOCO 5 News
feeds.description: KOCO 5 News is your source for the latest local headlines and live alerts. Visit Oklahoma City's most reliable source for breaking news.

feeds.title: Oklahoma Gazette
feeds.description: A refreshing tour of Oklahoma City's Arts, Entertainment, and Cultural background. Oklahoma Gazette's mission is to stimulate, examine, and inform the public on local quality-of-life issues and social needs, recognize community accomplishments, and provide a forum for inspiration, participation, and interaction across all media.
